evidence_layers.original_meaning: Holding a long-duration individual bond to maturity may return face value, subject to issuer and contract.

findings.disposition: Distinguish a specific nondefaulting bond with contractual redemption from a bond mutual fund/ETF NAV. Principal is not guaranteed merely by maturity: issuer default, call/prepayment, inflation, purchase price relative to face value, and liquidation before maturity matter. Bond funds commonly lack the identical fixed redemption date.
findings.decision_use: L1 risk/contract classification only; never certify a par-value or capital return on an unspecified bond product.

findings.disposition: 2026-01-01 onward: deferred-retirement income pension withholding 70% through actual years 1–10, 60% years 11–20, and 50% from year 21. Tax fraction applies to the corresponding income-source tax, NOT the entire account. An application to receive KRW10k alone does not prove an actual statutory pension receipt year.
findings.decision_use: L2 demonstration with actual receipt proof still required
